Subject: Handoff: Mediq Health — Implementation & Kickoff (SOW Signed)

Hi team,

Quick handoff: Mediq has signed the SOW (attached) and we're ready to move into implementation. High-level details below so CS can pick up ownership and set the kickoff.

Deal context
- Account: Mediq Health (RDW-2026-5489)
- Contract value: $420k ARR, 12-month term
- Committed go-live: target 2028-01-15 (pilot -> phased rollout)

What was agreed (short)
- Hosted API with dedicated throughput (reserved capacity) for the initial pilot
- Two models: text-generation + embeddings for search/rerank (we've verified latencies in the SOW)
- Monthly QPS commitment: 1200 tokens/sec average burst to 2500 tokens/sec

Current open items for CS
1) Kickoff scheduling and owner assignment (they prefer first-week-of-Oct)
2) On-prem connector scope (they want a VPC peering option during pilot — see IT notes)
3) Security/compliance evidence: they requested SOC 2 report and data retention policy (I attached the list)
4) Integration owners: internal contacts below (Emma = product owner, Pedro = infra SME)

Attachments (sent with this thread):
- Mediq_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)
- Mediq_Implementation_Roadmap.xlsx (xlsx)
- Mediq_API_Requirements.docx (docx)

Notes for CS:
- SSO: Mediq uses Okta; they will want SAML-based SSO and SCIM for user sync in phase 2.
- Data residency: primary in us-east-1; legal requested a short clause about log retention — legal already redlined.
- Success metrics: decrease semantic search latency to <200ms P95 on production dataset; embedding accuracy thresholds are in the Roadmap tab.

Asks: Monica — can you take primary PM ownership and propose a kickoff slot? Tessa — can you confirm implementation lead and proposed staffing? Vivek — FYI on SLA/credits that might be relevant if ramp is delayed.

Thanks — I'll remain on thread for questions.

[Attachment: Mediq_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Mediq_Implementation_Roadmap.xlsx (xlsx, 680KB)]

Cheers,
Ben

Monica's quick intake and proposed owners:
- Primary PM / Owner: Monica Patel (I'll run the kickoff and be the single point of contact for timeline and playbook)
- Implementation Lead (technical): Tessa Morgan — will lead integration, API onboarding, and runbooks
- Security/compliance escalation: Vivek Kulkarni — will triage SOC2 and any KMS/HSM questions

Immediate asks for Mediq (Emma/Pedro):
1) Please confirm which dates in the week of Oct 4-8 are available for a 90-minute kickoff. We will invite product, infra, and security SMEs.
2) Can you share a sanitized sample of the data they plan to index for embeddings (schema + sample rows) so we can size indexing jobs?
3) For VPC peering: is there a preferred CIDR or team owning the peering? If Pedro is the SME, we'll include him on the network prep docs.

Risks noted on first read:
- Their acceptance criteria reference a third-party latency test; we should confirm the test harness they will use.
- Roadmap shows a prefered phased rollout with SCIM in phase 2 — call that out to avoid scope creep.

I'll prepare a kickoff agenda and a pre-kick checklist (SAML metadata, firewall/IP allowlist, API keys, test dataset).

I'll take Implementation Lead. Draft timeline and first-steps below:

Week 0 (pre-kickoff, before Oct 6)
- Share kickoff agenda and invite (Monica)
- Get test dataset and SAML metadata (Emma / Pedro)
- Create dedicated Slack channel and invite list (I'll set this up)

Kickoff (Oct 6, 90 minutes)
- 0-15: Introductions & goals (Ben/Emma)
- 15-35: Architecture and security (Tessa / Pedro / Vivek)
- 35-65: API onboarding & sample calls (Tessa / Mediq dev)
- 65-85: Acceptance criteria and success metrics (Monica / Emma)
- 85-90: Next steps and owners

Owner map (first 30 days)
- Integration runbooks & API onboarding: Tessa Morgan
- Network & VPC peering: Pedro Alvarez (Mediq) / tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com (coord)
- Security evidence (SOC2, KMS): Vivek Kulkarni

Risks and mitigation

- If allowlist or firewall windows are wide, we will request a maintenance window for testing to avoid production disruption.

I'll send a Calendar invite for Oct 6, 10:00am PT (tentative) and include the kickoff docs.
